description: Give the person you act for (or this key's own page) a link to log in to LinkedIn. Logging in puts a LinkedIn-verified tick on their pro page (it means: this person logged in to this LinkedIn account), and that is what lets them be invited to a pro ask. Show the link and say: open it and log in to LinkedIn. Asks reads their LinkedIn profile once and keeps no access. Then call again with the `id` it gave: it says whether they are verified and, once they are, gives the name, headline, LinkedIn link and a handle to pre-fill set_my_page. One LinkedIn account verifies one Asks account. Spends nothing.

id.description: The id a first call gave: says whether the person is verified yet, and gives the profile to pre-fill set_my_page.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

name: connect_linkedin
title: Verify your pro page with LinkedIn
